Data Analyst

We are looking for a Data Analyst to turn product and sales data into insights that guide business decisions.

Responsibilities
- Write SQL queries to extract, clean and analyze data from our data warehouse
- Build dashboards and reports in Tableau or Power BI for stakeholders
- Define and track KPIs and investigate trends and anomalies
- Run A/B test analyses and communicate findings to non-technical teams

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics or related field
- 1+ years of experience in data analysis
- Advanced SQL and Excel skills
- Experience with Python (Pandas) or R for data analysis
- Solid understanding of statistics and hypothesis testing
- Strong communication and data visualization skills

Nice to have
- Experience with ETL pipelines and Airflow
